$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.assessment.JobRecord plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.
description: Durable payload for assessment_jobs lifecycle records emitted by `vigil assess kali job ...`.

parent_command_run_id.title: Parent Command Run Id
parent_command_run_id.description: ID of the assessment_command_runs row that initiated this dtach-supervised job.

status.title: Status
status.description: Job lifecycle state. queued: row written, dtach not yet attached. running: dtach attached, worker live. completed/failed/killed/lost/stop_failed: terminal states.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the dtach worker first attached.

ended_at.title: Ended At
ended_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the dtach worker exited or was killed.

exit_code.title: Exit Code
exit_code.description: Worker process exit code on terminal status.

dtach_socket_path.title: Dtach Socket Path
dtach_socket_path.description: Path to the dtach control socket, used by `vigil assess kali job tail` to reattach.

stdout_path.title: Stdout Path
stdout_path.description: Path to the worker's stdout spill file under ${ENGAGEMENT_DIR}/scans/kali/.

stderr_path.title: Stderr Path
stderr_path.description: Path to the worker's stderr spill file under ${ENGAGEMENT_DIR}/scans/kali/.

audit_metadata.title: Audit Metadata
audit_metadata.description: Audit metadata (technique, intent, probe_kind, destructive, phase, agent_name) captured at dispatch time.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp the job row was first written.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the most recent PATCH.

title: Assessment Job Record
